reply.text:
Shoulders respond to a few things done consistently: direct work for the side and rear delts, pressing that you can progress, and enough weekly volume that the muscle has a reason to grow. Most people do well with some lateral raises on most weeks, rear delt work a couple of times a week, and a main overhead or incline press they add weight to over time. Keep the reps in the 8 to 15 range for the raises, and push them with good form rather than swinging.

If you tell me which of those you already do, I can look at your logged training and see where your shoulder work sits. Do you want me to pull up your recent sessions?
